summary:
Mars Atlas is an interactive 3D mapping website designed to explore the surface of Mars. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and CesiumJS, the project allows users to navigate the planet, explore major geographical features, search for locations, view coordinates and elevation data, and measure distances between selected points.

The project aims to make Martian geography more accessible and engaging by combining scientific planetary datasets with an intuitive interface. Future development will focus on improving terrain detail, expanding the database of locations, and adding more scientific tools.
details: Mars Atlas is an interactive 3D mapping website developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and CesiumJS. It allows users to explore the Martian surface, discover major geographical features, view coordinates and elevation data, and measure distances between locations.
